shellCommands.command: cat package.json next.config.* 2>/dev/null; git status --short; find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -path ./.next -prune -o -path ./.git -prune -o -type f -print | head -100; ls node_modules/next/dist/docs/
for f in lib/products.ts app/products/\[slug\]/page.tsx app/layout.tsx app/page.tsx; do echo "=== $f"; cat "$f"; done; grep -ril "cacheComponents" node_modules/next/dist/docs | head -30

(npx next start -p 3123 >/tmp/s.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 4; for u in "lamp?currency=EUR" "lamp" "vase?currency=EUR" "nope"; do echo "== $u"; curl -s -o /tmp/o.html -w "%{http_code}\n" "localhost:3123/products/$u"; grep -oE "(EUR|USD) [0-9.]+|Brass lamp|Stone vase|Loading[^<]*" /tmp/o.html | sort -u | tr '\n' ';'; echo; done; pkill -f "next start"

(npx next start -p 3123 >/tmp/s.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 4; for u in "lamp?currency=EUR" "lamp" "vase?currency=EUR" "nope"; do printf "== %s " "$u"; curl -s -o /tmp/o.html -w "%{http_code} " "localhost:3123/products/$u"; for s in "EUR 110.40" "USD 120.00" "EUR 73.60" "Stone vase" "Brass lamp" "could not be found"; do grep -q "$s" /tmp/o.html && printf "[%s]" "$s"; done; echo; done; pkill -f "next start"
